records.deidentified_narrative: this is traffic fatality #79 for the city of dallas in 2021. see related [case id]. unit 2 pedestrian was in the parking stall area of the business parking lot of 9230 lyndon b johnson frwy [identifier] and was struck by unit 1. unit 1 was traveling northeast across the parking lot stalls of the business parking lot of 9230 lyndon b johnson frwy [identifier]. unit 1 drove over and dragged unit 2 pedestrian with the right side wheels, as unit 1 was accelerating forward. unit 2 pedestrian suffered fatal injuries during the crash. unit 1 left the location without stopping to render aid to unit 2 pedestrian. dallas fire rescue paramedics arrived on scene and found unit 2 pedestrian to have no signs of life at 6:51 am on [date]. there were no witnesses to the crash or video footage of the crash. based on the width of the tire evidence located at the scene, i/o determined that unit 1 was a truck tractor. it is unknown if unit 2 pedestrian was standing along the right side of unit 1 or in front of it, when she was struck. based on the unknown information and circumstances involving this crash, i/o was not able to determine which unit primarily contributed to this crash. two on-duty vehicle crimes unit detectives responded to the location. the on-duty traffic accident investigator responded to the location and completed a forensic 3d diagram of the scene. the crash scene and all interviews were recorded on i/o body worn camera. the video was saved to evidence. com on id #21-1299322. unit 2 pedestrian was positively identified from her fingerprints by a representative from the dallas county medical examiners office. this report is incomplete pending the identification of unit 1 driver and vehicle and the toxicology results of unit 2 pedestrian.
